svg.title: Local surface-code supports derived from cellular maps
svg.desc: Two matching square lattice patches use the same edge labels. Physical qubits sit at edge midpoints. A face f has chain boundary z equal to e1 plus e2 plus e3 plus e4, producing a Z plaquette. The dual vertex cochain v dual has coboundary x equal to e1 dual plus e4 dual plus e5 dual plus e6 dual, producing an X star. They share exactly e1 and e4, so x(z) equals zero over F two. The boundary complex and its dual supply the domains of these labels; Pauli labeling maps then turn them into commuting operators. These are local supports, not a complete finite surface code.
svg.text: x = δ⁰v∨ = e₁∨ + e₄∨ + e₅∨ + e₆∨
Local supports only. Logical qubits depend on global topology and the chosen boundary subcomplex.
